units.intent: Global logging support: the process-wide log-level mask, stack-trace dumping for the SLOG macros, and a copy-on-write parameter whitelist that redacts unlisted structured log params.

objects.name: _g_SLogMask
objects.role: atomic log-level bitmask read by the SLOG macros (declared extern in libstuff.h)

objects.name: GLOBAL_IS_LIVE
objects.role: when false, an unwhitelisted log param throws instead of being silently redacted

objects.name: SLogStackTrace
objects.role: dumps the current call stack at a given log level

objects.name: PARAMS_WHITELIST
objects.role: atomic<shared_ptr<const set<string>>> of allowed structured-log-param names, swapped via CAS

objects.name: addLogParams
objects.role: appends whitelisted/command-tagged params to a log message, redacting or throwing on the rest

objects.name: SWhitelistLogParams
objects.role: adds names to PARAMS_WHITELIST

objects.name: SIsLogParamWhitelisted
objects.role: queries PARAMS_WHITELIST

misfits.item: SLog.cpp's public API (SLogStackTrace, SWhitelistLogParams, SIsLogParamWhitelisted, addLogParams)
misfits.why: declared in the libstuff.h catch-all rather than a dedicated SLog.h, unlike other already-separated libstuff units

name_fit.note: name fits the content but the file has no header of its own

location_fit.note: declared in libstuff.h's catch-all rather than a dedicated header

naming_quality.note: _g_SLogMask (S-prefixed global marker) and GLOBAL_IS_LIVE (spelled-out global) use two different conventions for the same idea in one file

units.intent: Installs process-wide POSIX signal handling: crash signals get a best-effort stack trace logged/written to disk before abort(), and other signals are recorded in a bitmask that can optionally wake a poll loop.

objects.name: SSetSignalHandlerDieFunc
objects.role: installs the callback run just before a crash-signal abort to produce a final log line

objects.name: STerminationSignalCount
objects.role: count of SIGTERM/SIGINT seen so far

objects.name: SCheckSignal
objects.role: peek one bit of the pending signal bitmask

objects.name: SGetSignal
objects.role: peek-and-clear one bit of the pending signal bitmask

objects.name: SGetSignals
objects.role: read the whole pending signal bitmask

objects.name: SGetSignalDescription
objects.role: human-readable list of pending signal names

objects.name: SClearSignals
objects.role: reset the pending signal bitmask

objects.name: SInitializeSignals
objects.role: installs sigaction handlers and starts the background signal-handling thread

objects.name: SStopSignalThread
objects.role: stops and joins the signal-handling thread

objects.name: SSIGNAL_NOTIFY_INTERRUPT
objects.role: optional pointer to an SSynchronizedQueue<bool>, pushed to on any signal

objects.name: SSignalHandlerDieFunc
objects.role: the die-func called on crash

objects.name: _SSignal_signalHandlerThreadFunc
objects.role: background thread body: sigtimedwait loop dispatching signals

objects.name: _SSignal_StackTrace
objects.role: crash-signal handler: builds/demangles/logs backtrace, writes crash file, calls die-func, aborts

objects.name: __SIGSTACK / sigStackSize
objects.role: 64kb emergency altstack for signal delivery

misfits.why: a generic libstuff crash handler directly reaching into the sqlitecluster layer to kill peer connections on crash
bakes a product-specific filename into an otherwise general-purpose signal handler
the whole public API is declared in libstuff.h instead of a dedicated header, unlike most libstuff pairs

name_fit.note: does exactly what the name implies

location_fit.note: declarations live in libstuff.h rather than an SSignal.h; also entangled with sqlitecluster via KILLABLE_SQLITE_NODE

naming_quality.note: internal helpers consistently _SSignal_-prefixed; SSIGNAL_NOTIFY_INTERRUPT is an untyped void* though always cast to SSynchronizedQueue<bool>*
